en.name: Zeraora
en.description: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.effect: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

fr.name: Zeraora
fr.description: Il déchiquette son adversaire avec ses griffes chargées d’électricité. Même si sa cible évite l’attaque, elle reçoit un coup de jus.

attacks.name: Tonnerre
attacks.effect: Défaussez toutes les Énergies de ce Pokémon.

es.name: Zeraora
es.description: Hace jirones al oponente con sus garras electrificadas. Aunque este esquive los golpes, acaba electrocutado por las descargas.

attacks.name: Rayo
attacks.effect: Descarta todas las Energías de este Pokémon.

it.name: Zeraora
it.description: Fa a pezzi l’avversario con le unghie cariche di elettricità. Anche se il nemico schiva il colpo, riceve comunque una scarica folgorante.

attacks.name: Fulmine
attacks.effect: Rimuovi tutte le Energie assegnate a questo Pokémon.

de.name: Zeraora
de.description: Mit seinen elektrisierten Krallen reißt es Gegner in Stücke. Selbst wenn sie ausweichen, werden sie von elektrisch geladenen Funken getroffen.

attacks.name: Donnerblitz
attacks.effect: Lege alle Energien von diesem Pokémon ab.

pt-br.name: Zeraora
pt-br.description: Eletrifica suas garras e despedaça seus oponentes. Mesmo que seus oponentes desviem, eles serão eletrocutados pelas centelhas no ar.

attacks.name: Relâmpago
attacks.effect: Descarte todas as Energias deste Pokémon.

zh-tw.name: 捷拉奧拉
zh-tw.description: 會讓雙手雙腳的爪子帶電，然後將對手撕裂。就算躲開，也會用飛散的電擊讓對手觸電。

attacks.name: 十萬伏特
attacks.effect: 將這隻寶可夢身上的能量全部丟棄。
